text: Horrible customer service! Lady at register very rude will never go back!
Bar almost has a speakeasy bar feel. I came here for drinks. Not a large wine selection but better on beer and whiskey. Easy and calm vibe which was appreciated.

I'm so glad this place is open during COVID! I was craving something sweet and always heard of the beignets from the vintage! Hard to pick one flavor and they have a choice of the 3 flights! So I went with strawberry, blueberry cheese cake, and matcha. You know that feeling of eating something that reminds you of a great childhood moment! That's what happen with this amazing stuffed beignets! Literally and amazing pop tart or toaster strudel! You can't go wrong with going here for something sweet and the price was amazing! Will be returning soon! Also amazing staff and appreciate this place for being open!

I love this place and visit every year multiple times. This year was a little strange as the guys that work there were not very inviting or welcoming to dine in. The food this year was just ok. I will try it again next year and hope that some minor corrections can improve the service and what is being put out to the customer.

Came here last May for a light dinner out.  

Started with the a heady topper beer which is good.  

Forget what we started with since I was the last one to show up and got the Korean spiced tempeh sloppy joe which was good with fries.  

Good bar food and staff was friendly and they have the game on. 

My buddy likes this spot so likely I'll be back

Possibly for the happy hour lol

This was our first visit, but it won't be our last! The food was definitely a 5, but the service was a 3. There were 8 of us and we shared a number of appetizers and entrees. All were outstanding, but I particularly enjoyed the tender and flavorful lamb. The waiters appeared to be inexperienced and food was brought out piecemeal (for example, the pita was not served with the hummus, etc.). We had to request water, serve ourselves the olive oil, etc. one of our group was of Lebanese descent and he found the food to be very authentic.

Cheesecake Factory never disappoints. Tyler was our server and he took excellent care of us. 

Hubby got El Diablo to drink and he enjoyed it. For dinner, we stuck to our classic favorites. Hubby always loves the Jamaican Black Pepper Shrimp and he truly enjoyed it this time as well.

I got my favorite, Miso Salmon and loved it. I asked Tyler for a little more rice and he happily got it for me. 

For dessert we went with our most favorite, Fresh Strawberry Cheesecake and it was sinfully delicious as always.
Best Japanese restaurant in Tampa!   After living in Japan for three years.  This is the only place I go for amazing sushi, bentos, ramen, gyoza, and good Japanese beer.  They have it all!

Step back into a time when attention to detail meant a lot more than it does today. From the moment we arrived, I was comforted by the meticulous restoration of the building. The history here had me concerned of a gimmick clad place but I wasn't pleasantly reassured by their tasteful nod to the photos in the waiting area. Respect has been given to the people who made this place historic and to the building that protected them. Needless to say I was impressed.
The food was amazing! I got the pot roast which was perfection and a very tasty libation (but I can't recall its name). My husband got the hot chicken, which he loved. Others opted for the breakfast sandwich which they reported was good sized and very good. Also the service was very attentive and fast.
We will be back to Woolworths in 5th very soon!
I can't tell you how many times they've gotten my order wrong. Worst chipotle location I have ever been to - and I'm a chipotle fanatic.

Very disappointed with this Resturant.   Took my brother and two nephews there so we could sit on the rooftop outside.  We were  told by the four young hostesses that they were not seating anyone outside due to impending weather.   Not a dark cloud in the sky, in fact it was a beautiful evening and there were people sitting at the bar outside.   We ended up sitting inside on a beautiful evening and freezing inside the Resturant.    This review may sound petty  but I raved about how nice the rooftop was and the boys were excited to see the marina from up top.  In hindsight we just should of left and gone somewhere else to sit outside.    I think this Restaurant should have been more honest instead of the lame excuse we were given.  Isn't  the ambience part of the Resturant experience?

Finally! One of the necessary stops while in New Orleans. We got the lunch buffet featuring salad - the pickled veg was delicious , stewed okra and tomatoes, peas, carrot soufflé, smothered turkey neck, hot sausage, corn, and fried chicken. Delicious!

I did a pick up from High Hat- 1st time to try it. Outstanding. We had wedge salad, gumbo, catfish poboy with fries and pimento cheese macaroni- and pie. 
Starting with the pie- it was as good as any memory taste I have in memory banks- actually better, so save room.  
The wedge salad different but still great and had deviled eggs instead of the egg pieces. Delightful
Change to a favorite or mine. The large shrimp- amazing - and seasoned like they had been boiled in LA seasonings- so juicy as well. 
Every review I've read praises Mac and cheese. I totally agree- very nice change up, especially for a pimento cheese on bread sandwich spread fan. It's good- it's different-.and I'll probably get a hunger for it again soon... as long as they aren't out of that pie. 
Fries were good and came included on Poboy. I was disappointed with the 3, small catfish slices on it- they were good but left me wanting a couple more slices of catfish... taste wise - very good catfish!
Gumbo good-I'll need to get again because hubby ate most of it before I got more than a bite- he liked it he said.
Perfect size portions without leftovers- Affordable. 
The service blew me away. I gave the CC when ordering. I had husbands caretaker pick up-
she said it was the nicest people she ever met- they told her to please tell me how much they appreciated my business and wanted her to relay that message (can I say WOW!) 
I would recommend this resturant for food service and say to put in your list of must go! It

Food is a five.  They will even cook your fresh catch.  Stick to the beer!  But the seating system is a a disaster or this would be a 5!  Friendly staff works hard.  But the not taking names and no seating is a real problem.  People will surround your table.  Sometimes people just sit around and listen to the music and don't even order anything.  This place would actually make more money if it had a seating system or hostess.  Or some kind of how to get a table system.   Charge more for beer and food to pay for a hostess!

One of my favorite places to brunch in STL. The bottomless mimosas are only $15 and they offer multiple flavors and even a frozen option. I made my own meal out of the sides and was pleased with the taste. The service was also good. 

One downfall is that the game was in and the had it BLARING. Most places that aren't specifically sports bars don't even have the sound on. It got kind of annoying after a while, just wish they would've turned it down. There was a DJ (DJ Micro) he didn't even get a chance to spin while we were there.

Ok so I ordered this at work. First off the delivery driver leaves it outside without notifying anyone. If it wasn't for a patient coming into the office god knows how long it would of been sitting outside in the freezing cold. The Buffalo chicken egg rolls were very good but I've also had way better from a place in Richboro. The salad was good but too small. They were very cheap on the salad toppings. I'm not sure if I'd want to order again.

I'll start this off by saying their French toast is amazing. Their food is amazing.... but it's not when you wait 45mins to receive your food after ordering. After seeing every table around you get their food when they ordered after. When your food comes out cold but plate is hot? What the fuck is that. The server did not care. No one would let me speak to management. My food was not Redone. As a vet and as a faithful customer i will never return to this location again.

Hmmm saw the reviews and decided to give it a try. Love the inside of the place. Service was good. Food just wasn't imo. Maybe I got the wrong things. Got the queso. Just wasn't a fan of their take on it. I usually can't stop when I start eating. Took 3 bites and passed. Had the ahi tuna tacos, just have had better.

Such a fun place!! Get's very busy and is pet friendly.  Seating is very limited inside as place is small.  Worth the wait!  Everything is amazing!  Lots of seating outside, we had a group of four so we had yo steal a chair from another table!  Food comes pretty quickly and the orange juice is fresh squeezed!!!

We are from out of town, walked in just two of us wanting to eat and was told they were not taking anymore names.  The place doesn't close until 3 and we arrived at 12.  I am confused of what that really means, there were tables inside and outside and for a place that doesnt take reservations I am sure they could have taken my husband and I in.  If they were at capacity due to COVID okay, say that, because whatever she said was rude and out of pocket.  I'm not sure why she even felt she could say that to anyone, this is Philadelphia not Beverly Hills.
Extremely nice! They delivered a heart-shaped pizza to my long distance girlfriend while I am out of the state. I would highly recommend them!

This place is beyond special. The warmth and love that you get with delicious food makes you feel like you have been transported to a little town in Italy. I believe that you can touch lives when the person cooking adds love as an ingredient in the food as it's being made and served. Trust me, you will feel it.  Libby is absolutely precious and moved me to tears as she reminds me so much of my grandmother and Sal has a heart of gold and makes you feel like an old friend visiting him at his home.  I pray that God will bless this couple beyond measure and their imaginations.  I know this is the first of many dining experiences with my newfound family/friends.
It's a sports bar! Ordered the appetizer sampler and a beer...both were good, and the pickles were the highlight!

Right on bourbon street. Nice ambiance as my crew and I walked in with no wait for a table of four. My crew ordered catfish etouffee shrimp and grits and the red fish meal. I took away a star because you only get two shrimp with the shrimp and grits because it is measured by the weight rather than the number of shrimp.

I typically avoid the chain restaurants, but their Tuesday $5 craft burger special lured me from my bunker mid-pandemic.  My whole group agreed this burger/fries combo was far superior to other joints that offer similar early-week specials.

Delightful and delicious! Ordered the Sunshine Waffle, Samoas Mini Pancake, and a Chocolate Chip Walnut cookie that can easily rival the famous Levain NYC cookie. Lots of other delicious treats I have yet to try. I'd be proud to bring a box of these beautifully crafted pastries to a friend's house or give as a gift! Bri, the local owner has the most positive attitude even with the challenges of covid. She definitely pours a lot of love/pride into her craft! Looking forward to when we finalize our move and can become a regular patrons!
This place was amazing. I had the Lobster Daddy. Two fried lobster tails on a biscuit, smothered in, with an egg on top. Delicious!

This is my favorite sushi place in Tampa the fish is high-quality and the sushi rice is exceptional. The ambience is beautiful some of the waitresses wear traditional clothing and sitting at the sushi bar is a wonderful experience. I will continue to come until I find a better sushi place but I don't see that happening anytime soon.

We picked up some Giordano's last night and it did not disappoint. We got a deep dish pizza and some wings. The pizza had a delicious amount of cheese and the crust was just enough. It was pretty filling and I could only eat 1 piece. We also ordered some wings and I think this is the first place in a long time where the wings were a good size and you weren't left wanting more! Definitely recommend!!!

I've seen this place all over social media and Yelp activity, and I've been dying to try them out. Right now I'm on a week personal lock down, due to some travel so I had to go the delivery route.
Woa, so freaking good, I almost finished everything in one sitting, and I typically don't do that.
My avocado smoothie was amazing; who would have thought that avocado would be so drinkable? It was sweet without being super sugary, and it comes in a cool sealed cup! 
My pork belly bao was savory and a perfect starter, i love the look and taste of them.
For the main course, I had pho gao, and it was so good! The transport of pho is always impressive but it comes with the noodles, broth, sprouts, jalapeños, beef, and sauces. It's a build your own type of situation but if you pour and arrange the right way it's almost like being there! I really want to learn to make this one day. 
All around amazingly tasty food, that traveled well and was hot when I got it! I can't wait to come in an check out the brick and mortar location in a safe way!
We stopped in for a quick meal. Great drinks and crazy big poboy! We highly recommend this place for a unique atmosphere.

My husband and I have traveled a lot for work and have eaten a lot of pizza from different states and this bar far is the best pizza in St. Pete. The staff is extremely friendly. The owner is very personable. We find ourselves ordering pizza from here almost every week. You will not be sorry!!

My family of four were visiting from out of town and we had differing views on the experience at this restaurant for an evening dinner. First of all, none of us cared for the server and thought that he was arrogant and rude while taking our order. He wasn't any help on menu choices and seemed to be in a hurry to get the orders and move on. He also only brought dinner settings for two people even though there were four of us. 

As for the food, the seafood tree was pretty fair as well as the skillet mac-n-cheese, but it was no different than coming out of a box on the mac-n-cheese. The grouper tacos were dry and not all that tasteful which two of us had. The shrimp poboy was pretty good for one of  the people in our party. Overall, it was just a so-so dinner experience even though the restaurant is in a very scenic location on the bay. We will not be back again.

First-time visit and it was AWESOME! Wasn't sure how they'd handle the salad bar, but wait staff helps you by serving your choice of salad. For a steakhouse, the salad bar is FAB! Fresh and clean -- my favorite was the mango. Don't forget the chicken stroganoff.  For meats, they bring a variety to the table and you won't go hungry. Service is impeccable and our waiter, Marcos, was attentive, always available and had great suggestions. I highly recommend!
Gem of a restaurant that has been a family staple for years. Love it, try it, you are welcome.

I happened to stop by  on a search for a reasonable price breakfast. It was 10:30 am and the place was not very crowded, which was great.  I ordered the 2 egg special with grits and sausage.The coffee was good and the price was decent. The staff working there was nice and cordial.

I was very disappointed with the food taste. I had a falafel wrap with lettuce, onion, feta, and tahini along with a side of rice. The rice was the best tasting of all of it. The falafels were very bland. I've had a lot of tahini from many places and I have to say this one was the worst. I will not be going back.

Decided to have lunch here today.  I didn't even know it was here!  They only have outdoor seating right now in a move courtyard in the back. You must walk through the restaurant to get to it.
Started with the stuffed grape leaves and the feta and olives.  I had the spanakopita (spinach pie) and my friend enjoyed the veggie pita sandwich.
Everything was fresh and really good!

Delicious.

Ordered twice over the weekend we were here back in 2019. The only reason it has 4 stars is cause of the weirdly broken furniture that the soda machine sat on. Gave me serious anxiety. Kept waiting for it to fall over lol.

Wow, didn't realize it had been six years since I first found Smokin J's while on vacation.  Back in town and happy to say it was just as good now as it was then.  The biggest problem is trying to decide what to get.  You want it all.  Will have to visit again this week before leaving to get the other items.  Keep up the great work pitmaster John,

I just stopped for a bite to eat what a wonderful place to eat, and exceptional onion rings like I've never tasted before unreal. So if you stop in Boomtown, hopefully kenisha is working And you will be well taken care of, I guess I'm just biased I'm sure all the staff is wonderful. Thanks for your hospitality and great food thanks to a well managed kitchen,you are a magnet.......
Seafood kimchi pho.  Not found anything like this elsewhere. Enough spice / flavor to make worth the trip!!!!

We really enjoyed all our food and there is a nice vibe BUT the acoustics are horrible which made it hard for our table to have a conversation.  They don't have a lot of alcohol choices as I think they use all local small batch brands which was fine.   Go check it out, it's worth it.

I love this pizza restaurant. I order from here at least obese a week. An order was delivered which was not mine and they called and were so quick in getting my order out. It's a rough time for people and I'm thankful. I usually order the margarita pizza.

Baam Burger is a place you should avoid if you are in Nashville. We got two chicken sandwiches and they were of Walmart quality as they were brown and rubbery, the boxes the frozen chicken came in were literally sitting out in the open. AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS, the food is frozen and disgusting!!!!!!

If you want a good chicken sandwich in downtown Nashville you might as well go to a Chick Fil A.

Alright, Y'all. Must check out First Watch in Villanova!!! Freaking fantastic fare!! Had the Carrot Crush, Million Dollar Bacon (OMG!!), & Braised Short Rib Benedict. Food was near perfect! Many of the reviews stated that the service was slow. Our experience wasn't too bad. However, on a bad night I could definitely see long wait times. We waited just about 8 minutes for our server to speak her 1st words to us. Luckily, the menu was intriguing enough to keep us occupied for that time. I may not have noticed if I didn't start the stopwatch (I like to time service sometimes especially at a new place). Anyway, when she finally got to us, she was friendly and did what we asked of her quickly. The food was out in good time. I like my poached eggs a bit more runny but they were good. The girl at check in could've been quicker to acknowledge us, too! All in all, a good experience. The food alone was enough to bring us back. Service 3.25 / Food 4.5! Recommend!!
Went in for lunch for the family of 6, and staff went over the top for me!  Great service and my favorite BBQ & sides in Tampa area.  Take it from a Tampa native- Must try & return!

SHAME ON THEIR RAMEN. This the disgrace of Japanese Ramen, Japanese food, and Japanese culture. I ordered hot&spicy ramen with cost of $8.75 and I tipped them at the very beginning when I payed my order(Before service). I expected an answer that why they used instant noodle to serve their customers and never feel anything wrong with it. Why would I come to a restaurant to order a bowl of instant noodle that I can make at home in three minutes? ? ?

It was the first time in my life that I complained on the food I got. I went to the front desk and told the waitress that I was confused that they made the ramen from instant noodle. She told me that is what they serve and they are not required to tell us that from their menu. When I expressed my disappointment, she just looked at me, I had to ask and she said "What am I supposed to say?" Excuse me? It is the first time I met a waitress like this. And when I talked to the manger, who also claimed that that's what they serve anyway, and he also said, "I do not know what to say" . 

It 's just extremely disappointing that they are happy with the instant noodle they serve when they claimed that they provide RAMEN. And never feel sorry when their customer wish to have an explanation. Worst experience in my life.

This was my first time having Vietnamese food and, let me tell you, I'm obsessed! I happened to stumble across Chao when I was running errands and decided to stop in and get some food to take home for me and a friend. Every single thing we tried was delicious, balanced, and fresh. 

First up, we tried the pork banh mi, which was the perfect balance of crunchy, fresh veggies, rich, fatty pork, a kick of spice, and soft bread. Seriously. What a sandwich. We also tried the Vietnamese style tacos and they were out of this world good. Again, everything was perfectly balanced and simply incredible. While I waited for our takeout order, I sipped on a taro bubble tea at the recommendation of the person who took my order. This sounds crazy, but trust me-- the taro bubble tea tastes exactly like fruit loop milk! I really enjoyed it, but would definitely recommend it as a dessert items instead of something to drink with or before your meal. 

The food at Chao is not only delicious and balanced, but really well thought out and a truly beautiful dining experience. If you're vegetarian, you won't have any problems here, as the menu is super user friendly for those who have special dietary requests. I can't wait to head back to Chao for another banh mi and to try their pho!
Great atmosphere! Brunch menu is amazing! The mimosas were great. Will definitely be returning for more brunches.

If you're in the mood for sushi, I would highly recommend! Always consistent quality and presentation every time we visit! (I can't speak for the non-sushi menu items since I've never ordered anything but sushi, so come try it for yourself).

The take out experience here is excellent. The food is well prepared and appetizing so dining at home is not a problem. Fish quality remains excellent. The cost is competitive and rival St Louis Sushi restaurants. Everything including payment is done over the phone and no tipping to minimize unnecessary contact

I don't usually write reviews, but I felt compelled to do so. I wS looking for somewhere to have Mother's Day brunch near my daughter. They wouldn't take reservations so we didn't go. My wife and I happened to be off today, and decided to try it. The food was fabulous!!! We had the kitchen sink, and creme boulet French toast. It was wonderful!! We probably could have shared one item!! Service was a little slow but well worth the wait!

10/10 one of the best meals I have ever had! You need to try this place! The poutine was amazing! The guppa shots were fun and delicious. The curry...best thing I've ever eaten! Great service and super fun environment!

I'm not sure why it took me so long to try this place out. I ordered for take out and the food was ready quickly and packed well. We tried the burritos, I had the veggie one. The food was simple but so good! Get the guacamole, you get a lot of it and it's delicious.

We got delivery sushi from here a few nights ago and everything was incredible. I felt very comfortable with the delivery and the rolls were terrific. All the specialty rolls were really interesting and nicely prepared and even the simpler rolls were top quality. Will certainly order again.

Great food and service!  Onion rings and Chicago Style Oysters came out quickly for our appetizer. 2 beer battered grouper sandwiches, 2 beer battered shrimp dinners, salmon, and buffalo wings for the family. Everyone was happy and loved their meal. Mac and cheese was creamy, but could have used a bigger portion. My group had a great coating and was perfectly flakey. Friday special is $2 Key Lime Pie. Nice and tart for a perfect ending.

I loved the food and the decor of this restaurant. But the best part of our lunch was the excellent service from Connor who helped me pick two different craft cocktails and was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. I can't wait to come back.

Found this place on our yelp find a spot day. Today it was tacos. What a great find one of the best on our adventures. I even went back for seconds on the churro's which are beyond anything I've ever had before. From the sauces to the tortillas to the ingredients to the staff everything is fresh and 10 out of 10 you've got to give this place a try

Had a great experience here today!  Our waiter was extremely friendly and very helpful with ordering.  The wings were excellent!  I wish I got our waiters name, but I even left my sunglasses on the table and he ran a block after us to give them back to me!  Great spot!

I hope to have a chance to come back and give an updated review. Came in last Thursday. The place was pretty full, but there were a few empty seats. There was no formal host stand or sign saying what to do. There was an employee standing near the door in the kitchen area who was chatting with an employee who was cooking, and he watched us walk in and gave no directions. So in classic Nashville style we found empty seats at the long tables and sat down. A waitress came over and said we had to talk to the man standing by the door (the same man who watched us walk in, look around, and head towards the empty seats and never stopped chatting with his coworker or acknowledged us). We got up and said there were two of us, and he said they had an 'open seating policy' but it would be an hour and a half wait. Clearly he has no concept of what open seating means. When he said it was opened seating, and I pointed to the two empty chairs at the table, he explained the wait list procedure. I then asked if that applies to the bar seating along with the tables. Again, he said the bar was open seating, and again explained that there was a wait list. I tried to inform him that the procedure he was explaining was the opposite of open seating, and open seating means you walk in and find an open seat and it's yours. That was not the case in this scenario, where the seats were reserved for the next guests on the wait list. 
After this frustrating encounter, we walked out and went to one of the 50
Second time since living in Tampa that I have had Jets pizza. It is AMAZING. It was exactly what u wanted, delivered quickly and tasted phenomenal!

I was visiting Nashville & went to Trader Joe's one day & noticed Fox's donut shop. I didn't go that day but did make it there another day & another day. Yes I end up going twice. Donuts were delicious, although a little pricey . Pleasant staff.

Couldn't wait! Had to get a breakfast Philly cheesesteak! Full of giant chunks of onions and mushrooms and heaps of flavorful, paper-thin steak! 

Hubby's only critique? Needs more cheese. Haha! Personal preference, but I agree.

We're done. This Sonic, like the rest of the Sonic Drive-ins in Tucson is complete trash. Time and time again we are given grotesques variants of their advertised menu items. The staff is always rude and incompetent. The staff appears to hates their job and hates doing business with their consumers and the business is always filthy. And now this, the Coney dog footlong meal with extra chili and cheeseI "missing" just purchased has part of the bun missing, the hot dog is broke in the middle and when I took the first bite I had to "literally" spit the bite out to keep from gagging. The hot dog is so old it has a metallic chemical spoiled taste. I really don't know how to explain it any better than that. I should have listened to my eyes and never attempted to push this vile crap into my mouth. My advice,  DO NOT EAT HERE!

I've been to quite a few number of Mexican restaurants and I am traditionally pessimistic if there is too much attention on flare in exchange for substance, but Lolita did a great job in enticing both the mind and the taste buds.

Must get: cobb salad, carne asada (main dish), malanga+plantain chips, guac (regular is just fine), nachos
Meh: fish tacos, Mexican corn (just too much), margaritas, pork taquiza
Missed out: happy hour

It's kind of weird when the item that stood out the most was the cobb salad, but when you add quality ingredients with lime vinaigrette,
jicama, pepitas, cotija, how can you go wrong? I do think that the herb-buttermilk dressing may have been a bit of an overkill (made the salad much more soggy), but overall, it was definitely one of the more memorable dishes. As for the other dishes, I recommend the guac (we had the mango guac - see photo), but just plain regular as the mango version adds little more than just an expensive, but non-taste altering experience. The wife loved the nachos and she definitely went nuts over the generous portions of braised shortribs over the bed of freshly fried nachos. The garnishes make this dish seem slightly healthier...but that's purely for illusions only.

I was a bit disappointed by the mexican corn...don't get me wrong, slathering a piece of corn on a cobb with chipotle mayonesa, cotija, lime, ancho sounds and taste great...but so does a fresh corn on a cobb, and it was just too much. I tried the fish tacos and the

Yum!!! I passed through town while traveling and discovered this gem. This place is so good and they have gluten free options that are actually awesome! I got a takeout including a make-your-own scramble with corned beef & Swiss with their amazing potatoes, and I had mini gf pancakes that were the best gf ones I've ever had. The lady who took the order gave me great recommendations and was super nice & efficient! I wish there was one of these near me!

We needed something quick to pick up so we ended up at drive thru. It's been three years or more since our last time, (didn't really like it).

It was late in the evening, asked if they had any specials, and ended up with a 10 piece meal! (Only 2 of us)!

Nicely surprised how fast we got our order, and the smell activated my hungriness.

Let's just say we will be coming back l!!!

Normally, I don't eat leftover, but I did this

11/10/19 Update:

After running all my errands, (last night we drove by and the line was too crazy) I planned my last stop here.
11:25 and no line in the drive thru!??? But wait...
They blocked it off... that's why there was a bunch of cars in the lot!

A guy walked in before me, so I was asking him if he was getting the sandwich, and he was.

Lucky me only had 4 people in front of me, and about 6 behind me.

Of course, (thinking ahead), I also got chicken for dinner.
Stopped at McD for the fries, and headed home.

Hubby was shocked I got the sandwiches! 

The spicy was good, moist and very good portion size..

Glad I got to try it, but I think I'll stick with chicken on a bone.

Service is horrible from the start and you can tell soon as walk in... Tables with no guest are dirty and no one cleaning them off... Line forming at front and not a single employee even making eye contact to the door. They take the couple ahead of us and than poof disappearing act like we weren't there waiting.  You wait at the door for 10 minutes or so and finally have to signal to the back hey what the fuck need to be seated.... 

Once you get seated you think ok maybe they got the jist... Nope .... You sit and get quick help  and get chips and your drink and guess what you do after ?? You wait and wait and wait and wait longer.  And right when you are about to get up to leave they come and finally take your order ... 

As I write this more came in and just waited and as I write this more just left.

As far as the food. Bland and sucks. Had chicken tacos and no season no flavor.. pretty much got chicken out heated it up put on flour tortillas ..

Place won't stay open long with how bad the service and the food was awful 

GO ANYWHERE ELSE BUT HERE !!
Food is very good. Wings are crunchy and the mango habenero is great with a slight kick. Car side deluvery people are more than helpful especially since I was new to the area. I will be back for sure

From the food to the atmosphere, this place will make you feel all warm and fuzzy. The hearty breakfast food is incredible. The corn bread is the perfect blend of moist and crisp on the outside. The grits are the best I've ever had, creamy with delicious everything seasoning. The rustic country atmosphere is incredibly comfortable and homey. Definitely worth checking out!

I ate from this place a few times now and the food is GOOOOOOOODDD. You get a very nice portion of everything. I got the snow crabs,shrimp ,broccoli and potatoes. The butter is a different taste than what I'm used to as it tastes a little sweet . Overall if I'm in the NE I'm going here for seafood .
Great Mexican food in Marana. Friendly service and great homemade dishes always served with fresh chips and salsa, alcoholic beverages as well.

They reopen this weekend!!! Yea!

This is our Moo Shu (so) connection!

Always excellent, great service, they have my phone number on file and know my likes.

Easy to business and we missed them while closed for COVID-19

Why is there only one server and one kitchen cook? It literally took me almost two hours to get a single meal. It wasnt either of their faults they were working hard but shame on management for only scheduling two people to run an entire restaurant wtf
If you ever have a hankering for some very nice Cajun Creole this is the place to go. The drunken Angel was a nice change of pace for pasta even the pastor had flavor to it it was not bland at all.

This place was the best we have had hands down. We both had filet migon and oh my God so tender well cooked melted in your mouth. Everything we order from start to finish was perfect our server Cory was great very attentive and friendly. We differently recommend this place you can't go wrong. Enjoy!!! 
The Orona's

We walked in with a party of 18 yesterday for dinner.  We could not have chosen a better restaurant.  My husband and I are locals but the others are all visitors.  They had a blast.  Our server Cookie handled  a rowdy group like a true professional playing with everyone and truly making dinner a fun experience.   Everyone was thrilled with their food, the specialty drinks were great.  I cannot recommend the Quarter location of Mahoneys enough- ask for Cookie!

Located in the heart of Maplewood, I have wanted to try this place for a very long time and am so happy I finally got the opportunity to! The décor is so beautiful in this restaurant. I couldn't help but stare! The menu is more of a Mediterranean style. There are lots of choices and the plates are easily share-able. The menu seems to change quite frequently. We were a group of 4 and ordered multiple dishes to be shared by all of us. We ordered some salad, some eggplant and some shishito peppers off the "salatim" menu. We also ordered the falafel to start as well as some hummus. We then ordered a meat to share for the four of us and all of us were extremely full towards the end of it!  Loved this restaurant and would like to come back!

Such an amazing experience from beginning to end. Our server Sara delivered the best service, our meals came out with great timing and she made sure our drinks were always filled. She provided all the side items for the table, such as salt, pepper, ketchup without ever having to ask for it. She surely took great care of us and made us feel like vip. The manager Marcy stopped by and greeted us with such a warm welcoming approach. She noticed we were getting creative with our burgers and got a kick out of it. We sure felt like family and can't wait to come back. Thank you for such a pleasant evening!!
Great view from this rooftop restaurant and bar. We just had a drink and was nice to be outside. The service was slow at the bar, but I'd like to try dinner sometime.

Solid spot for Asian fusion, but "management" is apparently prejudice.  I was there last week with four other well-dressed gents, who all happen to be African-American (dressed in a full suit or sport coat).  As we were sitting at the bar ordering food via our cool bartender, which like most bars is usually loud, the manager comes up with a nasty attitude and says "shut up, you're too loud." Then gets on the phone as if he calling the police saying "they are too loud."  We asked what's the problem, he repeats "you too loud, shut up." He didn't go say this to anyone else at the crowded bar, just us.  Wow. The bartender said he didn't understand what his deal was.  We cancelled our order immediately and left.

Ok for real we love Derek. And will go back for his service alone!! Very engaging, lively, and has fantastic suggestions for dinner when I was at a loss and slightly confused. And this food is top notch. UFO... unbeatable food operator (from Derek)
Attended prior to Toby Keith concert. Place was very busy. A/c was unable to keep up. Ask prices for specials. Normal entree items probably a better value. Wait time exceeded one hour for food.

My husbands mother was in town so we always try and find a new place to enjoy! We had reservations and were seated immediately! We ordered the salsa trio and guacamole. Both were great. Our table ordered different tacos, fajitas, soup, and enchiladas and everything was very good. Drinks were very good but bar service getting our drinks was very slow! The table ordered another round of drinks before our food came out and we were almost done with dinner before our second round came out! Food was good and our waiter was good also! Overall decent experience. Will be back!

A ++++
Not much else to say. Great service, a small selection of beer/wine/cocktails.  Super friendly staff, and food exactly as describe.  I hope they expand to another location.

I'll be back on a regular basis.

This place was actually pretty good. I'm from Sacramento and knowing there's plenty of Korean bbq here. This place actually is really good. Great customer service and Price was a decent prices. I would highly recommend. Definitely coming back when I visit Reno.

Came for dinner on a Thursday evening.  They had a decent selection of beer for a chicken place.  We ordered 1lb of chicken wings ($9.58) and a half cup of mac n cheese ($5.20). I was disappointed by the chicken; very dry outside, yet greasy.  The chicken is only bearable with some kind of sauce that they charge extra for.  The Mac n cheese was ok, but nothing extraordinary.  Honestly, would've preferred Popeyes or KFC even at the same price.

So inconsistent. Understaffed/undertrained/ not a team environment. Managers don't know how to perform at certain roles to help out. Online system doesn't accurately state the time it takes for food to come outa kitchen can be super slow and there's rarely people dining in. I've waited 40+ mins for a small order of wings before.
Amazing vegetarian food and the Michelada is incredible. Absolutely love coming here and the service is always amazing!

Their food is consistently good. This place is a staple of ours. Staff are friendly and always helpful. I typically don't dine in but that's a personal preference. This is my go to spot for Gyro's. Love the Tabouleh and their cucumber sauce never disappoints.

This place is horrible. First, Friday night of March Madness opening weekend and none of the ATMs are functional. Their response? "It's not our problem." Oh, awesome. What about players for roulette? Blackjack? Poker? Slots? Etc? "It's not our problem." Not only that, when we did sit down at table games for over one hour, no drink service at all. No comps. No "Sorry for the inconvenience" no nothing. Sat down at the bar, which was fairy full, operated by 2 bar bartenders. Waited 30+ minutes for a round of beers. If this "casino" wants any sort of credibility, they might want to start by taking care of their young affluent players. Or at very minimum, have functional ATMs. Or, and here's a crazy thought, offer comps to your players who have been inconvenienced by lack of amenities and services. Until someone takes notice, I would give this casino ZERO stars, and move for all management to be fired. Sincerely, Disappointed.

UPDATE: Just had a bar tender tell me, "ATMs are back up!" Awesome, I thought. I went to the ATM, only to realize the bar had my debit card. Upon return to the bar my seat and drink had both been taken. I saw a man in a suit and official looking lanyard, I asked, "Excuse me, are you in charge?" To which he answered, "I work the table games, if you have a problem with service take it up with 'them'." When I professed my grievances about the nonfunctional ATMs, the non-service at table games, the extremely long wait for service at the paid bar, all he answere

Yech! Want salt? They got it! First the salad came out with rotten lettuce with the dark spots. The waitress brought another. Same thing. A little argumentative. When the chicken marsala finally came out I guess my request to not add extra salt was understood to mean pour on as much salt as possible. Late, so forced myself to eat that but couldn't force myself to eat the broccoli which tasted like rubber and earth. Some machine provided a nice rattly compressor noise. I paid my bill -- my ticket to freedom -- I got out of there!
Festive was amazing Mexican food with a more formal atmosphere - perfect for a  date night. The restaurant was beautiful and the food tasted great! Would recommend the chicken enchilada!

Fucking Amazing! been going here over 15 Years!!
The Food is phenomenal! my Go-To's is the Jerk Chicken , Oxtails, PepperSteak!! This restaurant is the most authentic Jamaican Cuisine I have ever went to. I only know if (2) places in Philadelphia that has Great Authentic Jamaican Food  & Little Delicious is Definitely one of them.

Yum! Yum! It's so good! I got the Italian beef sandwich. It is amazing. I got it 'wet' which means they dip the whole sandwich in au jus. OMG! I love it. They have great fries and salads too. I've also had the Chicago hot dogs. My husband likes the sausage sandwich. 
And Portillo's does 'to go' with great efficiency. Even before the pandemic they had it down to a science.

You need to learn how to  run a business... you co to us to send me texts with a 10% Discount`, yet when you call as I did tonight and was told "due to corona virus you are not accepting discounts..  I might add despite you using this same excuse 3 months ago, you may wa t to come up with a new excuse.. you have lost my business!!!    In a time when people are extending discounts to try to stay in business you choose to chase business away..    do t send text messages !!  Anyone reading this  should go to Place of Asia .  The food is better , the staff is more professional, and they don't  try to scam their customer over a minimal 10% coupon... I want to support local family owned businesses to help them survive during these times.. well I hope you go out of business !!

This place is NOT a cookie cutter coffee house patterned after the local java syndicates (you know who you are). The cafe is clean and open but not sterile. We were struck by Ugly Mugs' professional but unpretentious staff. The espresso is great and as a bonus, the food was even better. We didn't go too adventurous, avocado bagel and a lox/cream cheese bagel. Both were delicious, perfectly toasted, (get the everything bagel) great price point considering what we're used to. 
Nice!

I was craving some good wine to relax this weekend and thought of Villa. I'm so glad I went! They have a bunch of specials!!! The owner helped me pick a couple of good bottles. I felt very comfortable and well taken care of.
Thank you Villa for always helping your customers feel at home!  LOVED MY WINE BTW  Can't wait for businesses to be fully open again so I can go back and enjoy a fun night with live music

Last evening me n my boyfriend had reservations, and when we got there we had a time finding the entrance; as it is located on the far side of the building.  When you walk in the restaurant is decorated very nice.  However that was as far as the pleasantries went for us. We got there early, and they seated us at the worst table in the place. Right by the door and even after repeated attempts they would not move us. Even when more tables became available, they refused to move us. The waiter seemed like he made no effort on the service but he did do his job andn took our order. My food thankfully was good, but my bf tomahawk pork chop was so dry,but we did not complain. I wished I had went somewhere more friendly but on Valentine's weekend its nearly impossible to get a new reservation someplace else. They were not friendly especially the little hostess at the door. Normally I hate when someone doesn't tip because I have been a server too, but this was one time where I could not justify any reason to do so! And I gave the two stars because at least one meal was worth it!
The food was good, but so tiny for the price! I was shocked when I saw how tiny the lobster sandwich is!!!! Not filling at all
Excellent! I had chicken schwarma wrap and my lunch mates had lamb and chicken kabobs with rice. Food was all delicious and presentation very nice. Excellent service too!

We came here after visiting my brother and sister in law that just moved to the area. Covid was in full swing so the place was not busy at all. We were seated quickly and the hostess was very nice. It took about 10 minutes to get a waitress to the table for our drinks and drinks took a few minutes longer than expected. We ordered stuffed mushrooms for an appetizer. It took about 10 minutes to get these out, and when they arrived they were still frozen on the inside. The waitress was very apologetic. After all the other bumps, the food was ok, nothing to be excited about. We probably wont be coming back soon. Could be an alright spot for sporting events and cheap beer.

Beautiful restaurant with some really yummy food.  Authentic Szechwan Chinese dishes to American Chinese dishes. Amazing flavors with many meat as well as many non meat options. Karaoke after 9pm every night , with a private room for parties or karaoke parties, live music Friday-Sunday 7pm-9pm. Love it, will be returning.

Ordered small Quatro Fromaggi pizza at 3 AM from Uber Eats.  The BEST pizza I have eaten in my LIFE, including in Europe. SERIOUSLY. 
The crust was clean, classic, perfectly textured and cooked.  The cheeses were authentic, rich, and flavorful.  I had no idea this local  treasure existed. I'm ordering more TONIGHT. Can't wait to visit in person.
We love the family style dining at Mimi Blue Meatballs. All of the meatball varieties are delicious, as are the side dishes (try the Brussels sprouts!).
Very disappointed!! I gave up after waiting over 45 minutes for a to go order. Staff seemed friendly enough just not at all prepared for a lunch rush or a grand opening.

Came to this spot for breakfast. I always enjoy trying new restaurants. Especially the all American classic breakfast diner. 

This place for sure looks like the classic vintage Reno eatery. Oldie but goodie. 

Once inside you're greeted by a friendly hostess. Restaurant was very clean inside this includes the restrooms. Very clean and they have a magnetic lock to prevent non customers from using the restroom. 

Our waitress and bus boys were friendly and attentive. The food was really good. I got the ground beef patty and eggs. This dish was really good. 

My lady got the biscuits n Gravy. Another good dish that was good. 

Over all it was a good food experience. I would recommend this place and would come back upon my return to Reno.

If you're lucky enough to snag one of the few free street parking spots then you can avoid the $10 lot accords the street! Pretty long wait even for a Monday afternoon but thankfully they have the Champagne, coffee and tea bars to keep you busy as well as their gift shops on either end. We waited for about an hour & 1/2 for a party of three and got drinks at the Champagne Bar! You can order champagne cocktails or straight champagne by the glass. I got the punch cocktail and it was not only pretty but slightly sweet-just how I like it! Got seated for lunch in the bright and welcoming Indoor patio with glass roof and fountain. Ordered the sangria to drink which I was pleased by the size of the glass as well as the chicken burger with a side of truffle mac and cheese. Food came out fast and the service was very attentive. Large portions so I split my meal. The burger was delicious! Nice and juicy and tasty! Fries were excellent and the Mac & cheese was yummy! Would definitely recommend and be back myself!

I had high hopes for this place but I was very disappointed. Let me first say that my waiter was exceptional. He was very friendly and attended to me very well. I love great customer service and he definitely delivered.  Unfortunately, the food was horrible! I came in for breakfast. I ordered the chicken fried steak breakfast. My first red flag should have been the fact that when I ordered,  my food came out literally 2 mins later. Big sign that the food wasn't fresh. My potatoes tasted like they were cooked first thing in the morning and were justed heated up. The steak tasted old as well and didnt have good flavor at all. And who messes up eggs? My scrambled eggs weren't even cooked all the way. The best thing in my plate was the housemade jam.... thats all. Worst experience ever with breakfast.

Ordered in person, asked for no chicken as we are vegetarian, repeated this several times. Got home and every dish had chicken in it.

Can't review anything about the quality of the food as I wasn't able to eat any of it.

Beware!  First time ordering from here and will be my last.  Ordered via bite squad for delivery. Food arrived very fast, BUT the bone in ribs were putrid!  I'm not talking a hint of a bad odor, it gagged me and my husband. As soon as I opened the bag I smelled rotting meat. There is no chance that they didn't realize the ribs were spoiled, not with how rank they were.  This tells me very poor quality control.

Unfortunately we were all quite disappointed. During the week we ate at so many great restaurants. Now we know why there isn't a line at Felix's. The food was just meh. I ordered the oysters Bienville. This dish was a huge swing and a miss!  It was served cold with a congealed cream sauce. It was $23. Big disappointment. The fish and shrimp platter wasn't bad, but certainly not as good as a famous spot across the street with a long line starting with the letter "A" .  We were a party of 9 and all agreed. Too many better places to eat.

Had Curbside last night and it was awesome!  The only thing missing was the exceptional service we get while dining in!   But our curbside service was awesome and they are very appreciative of the support!   The new Tacos and Meatballs were amazing as always!

Me and my friends used to love this place but today the service has been horrible !!! It has gone extremely downhill. In the past, a waiter has spilled water on my sister but today was the worst. I arrived her me at 6:30 and my friends still have not gotten their food and it is 8:04-- they simply ordered a crunchy roll. Our miso soup also took 45 minutes; for a pre-prepared appetizer that is ridiculous.  Will not be returning because of my waiter. He is genuinely the most incompetent waiter I have ever had.

Great food, great service and great vibes from great people!
They also have a large alcohol selection priced to sell

Finally great Korean food in Nashville! 

Do yourself a favor and get some Galbi and a kimchi pancake.  

The food is fresh, tastes great, and authentic Korean food. 

We will be frequently dining here.

I really wanted to love Larry's but it didn't meet my expectations and the hype. Average iced cream and gelato. Way too sweet. No strawberries in my gelato at all. We also ordered donuts. Those may have been better than the iced cream. The kids ate it for what it's worth. The long 45 minute line to get it just didn't meet the quality of ice cream. Service was friendly and quick. I liked that. 

But can't say I'll be back.

During the summer months this restaurant is always packed. They have a great atmosphere with a back patio that overlooks the canal. We went with a party of 6 and the service was fantastic. Everyone loved their meals and were happy with the service. They had great drink specials and a menu that offers something for everyone!

Rays is the first vegan restaurant I went to when I moved to St. Pete. I reviewed what others were saying about this establishment and I couldn't refuse giving it a try. I mean, who doesn't LOVE soul food that's vegan. So far I've had the "fish" made from banana blossoms, buffalo Mac, jerk Mac, the Reuben sandwich, coca mate tea, and the Irish soda cake. 

The staff is always inviting. The owner Ray, is always there to answer any questions and absolutely kills the vegan game. 

The meals are fresh, homemade, and AMAZING. I'm disappointed that I ate too quick to take a picture. I love Ray's Vegan Soul so much that I went back twice in the same day! The cashew cheese in the mac is perfected and creamy. The fish and Reuben sandwich were some of the best meals I've ever eaten. I can be picky when it comes to tea, Ray let us try his coca mate tea and it was so refreshing. You could taste the fresh local mint and the sweetness was perfect. 

The location is a close to the edge district. The atmosphere of the restaurant is small, simple, and clean. There is outdoor seating as well. This establishment is only opened Friday, Saturday, and Sunday and they STILL won the award for the best restaurant in Tampa Bay. That says A LOT. I recommend this local gem to everyone, plant based or not!
I'm so mad. I only come here for one specific item I'm craving and when I get home, the food is a waste, the can is rotted, and food is spoiled! It's a expensive too! Not willing to come back again
I love this place!  Not only is the food fast and fresh, but the staff are great too.  They are very attentive and always have a smile to share.

Ate there last night at the bar. Came in a little after nine. No one at the bar. The bartender was awful. He seemed more concerned on stocking his bar then taking care of us. He just generally seemed annoyed and as though he didn't want to be there. Our food was average. I say that because the wings weren't good. They were breaded and no where did it say that on the menu. The only highlight were the truffle fries. Did I mention the bartender stunk, oh yea!  Definitely wouldn't return!

My recent lunch at Galatoire's was a fantastic experience as usual with good friends, good food and good people... Yet it was VERY concerning as the restaurant was deserted except for one other gent eating alone and our table of four.  The French Quarter was also quite deserted and there are still too many places boarded up and closed down.  Our economy can't survive like this and the epidemiological data no longer justifies such strict shut down measures as at this point medical necessity in no way justifies this current situation.  Our veteran waiter has been working at Galatoire's for longer than I have been alive and he had been hospitalized and nearly died from COVID-19 and he also needs and wants business to return to as nearly normal as possible!  Other tourist destinations around the country are having economic booms (Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge, the beaches of Alabama and Florida along with many other spots). Even Jefferson Parish has more going on than the French Quarter at this point.  

The politicians need to STOP playing the typical corrupt Louisiana political games and instead use data driven epidemiological practices.  The data clearly shows that it is quite safe for most folks to return to nearly normal while high risk folks can continue to take elevated precautions.  Just my informed opinion of course as somebody that has seen the rest of the world and also has graduate level epidemiology courses on my university transcript along with a lot of experience with a

Ah, 7 ounce. 
I want to say you have failed me so- but in all honesty I knew this was bound to happen. It's the same owners as Azian and they did the same exact thing there. 
Bought a vacant spot, spruced up the place real nice and fancy like- with what seemed great menu, quantity, quality and great service, but after some time and once the hype goes down - they resort to bad service, broken grilling tables, fan doesn't suction up the smoke, prices increase in areas you don't notice like the side dishes and drinks, and to top it off - the bathroom is in very very poor condition. Literally, one of the stalls has a broken lock..... takes 1 min with a screwdriver to just screw it in correctly. 
Here's the breakdown.

5 Location, still nicely located on Speedway and Swan in the Sprouts shopping center 
1 Decor, is actually nice and can tell everything is newly renovated, but with the low upkeep in cleanliness- definitely lowers the rating 
1 service, was very poor. The host seemed so tired and her shift just started! As they traditionally yell out " Welcome to 7ounce" the volume, and enthusiasm has definitely left the building. I would rather have them not shout it out rather than have 1 employee say it in a dreary tone and the one other person to say it as a annoyance. 
1 Price, was not bad when they first opened with many options for happy hour, but that has been depleted completely.
1 quality and portion is bad.... 
* We literally had broken pieces of debris in the egg souffle

Now this is BBQ! Cornbread is silly good, brisket is amazing....just an overall great place.

Plus the service was top notch.

A very safe bet for a great bbq meal.
Very friendly. Clean place. Excellent food! The staff were very nice. Excited to try everything on the menu!

This place is a true gem! We've been going here for years and years and it is always our go to spot for dinner! They are doing an amazing job during quarantine as well! A free roll of toilet paper with each order as well as frequent sanitation even on the pens to sign with! Food never ever disappoints! Check this place out if you haven't had the chance, you won't regret it!

3rd time ordering from these guys through the Covid pandemic and they have been outstanding every time!!!
Every burger we've had so far has been delicious!!
And we tried the taco's this last round and they were fantastic!! The chicken is my favorite so far!!

After over a year of wanting to eat at Hippie Kitchen, I finally made it there for dinner.  

There's a tight, but decent-sized, parking lot & the lighting/art on the walls creates a great ambience.  Beautiful breads & pastries graced my senses as I entered the establishment.  Service staff is highly knowledgeable, sweet, & attentive.

The Friis, Please was a decent drink, but not quite to my taste.  I was perfectly satisfied with the House Salad.  The Chef's Hot Pot was the Chicken Pot Pie the night that I visited &, let me tell you, I would order that again in a heartbeat.  The roux in the Chicken Pot Pie was darker than I'm used to & wonderfully flavorful.  Its crust was almost crispy on the outside, while having a dumpling-like consistency on the inside.  Sooo delicious.  The Spaghetti with Meatballs contained just the right amount of pasta & sauce.  I sampled a meatball, which was great & tasted homemade.  I'm guessing that the Cinnamon Roll I was served had been sitting out too long, because I struggled to cut it until it was heated up.  After it was heated, I still couldn't eat half of it for how hard & dry it was.  Sadly disappointing.

Overall, there are more hits than misses at Hippie Kitchen.  I'd love to explore the breakfast & brunch menus to get a full perspective of what this place can offer.

Tonight the family decided to try this place, saw the hype, we live just down the street and they had a pretty good grand opening with a live band but this is the first time we've been in. Six people total, friendly atmosphere quick service. This is just a Los Betos copy under a different name.  I ordered the Chicken chimichanga and it was just ok, no care on the prep as the chicken was all at 1 end and the cheese was all at the other.  Very dry too.  Others in our party had burritos and they said they were good too... but we all unanimously agree Los Betos is a better pick and a bit better food, consistently.  Hot sauce bar is really nothing to speak of too.  Friendly staff though.

The food is really good.  Where this place lacks is attention to detail.  I asked for tacos without onions unfortunately the tacos arrived with onions.  Overall the service is good and I would go back again. Flavor is where they won me over!!

Surprised how this place has such great reviews. After hearing a lot of good things about this place. We finally decided to place a Togo order. And, boy I was disappointed. I ordered parang curry & asked for it to be medium spicy. All it tasted was like coconut milk with veggies & chicken in it with no spices at all. Probably even forgot to add salt to it. The curry was way too liquid. Pad Thai was average with exactly 2 pieces of shrimp in it.
People who end up giving this place a 5 star probably haven't had real good Thai food or May be the day I placed my order they didn't have the usual cook.
But, definitely was a disappointment!

Restaurant is new and clean.  Service was fast.  Sushi was good and very reasonably priced.  All you can eat during the weekdays was only $18.95.  The only negative was that the all you can eat selection was limited but still more than enought to choose from.  I will definitely go back.

Ordered A take out order for work and had about 8 orders total... two of the orders had HAIR in them, so we called the restaurant and they were rude  about the whole situation, the so called female manager on duty needs to take cutomer care 101 over because she has a horrible disposition and especially in a management position!  I hate to leave a review like thIs but the response to our dissatisfaction was awful after we spent $200 on a take out order!  To top it off we were told we would have to speak to "corporate" regarding this issue... really this restaurant group is corporate now?!?!??
The food that was edible was good but the rest is  much to be desired!!  Won't be back here!
This wing place is off the chain! I always try new wing places in Tucson, & this is by far my favorite place. I always get the ATL Style wings, and its so fire!! 10/10 recommend to anyone

A great spot on the east side serving up delicious and authentic po boys and Cajun food. Right now there isn't any inside seating but there are always lines out the door waiting for the delicious food. Order ahead to avoid waiting. I went for a classic shrimp po boy and a side of French bread. Look for the changing desserts and specials of the month.

Not only was the food great but the service was excellent. It was my first time going there and the cashier explained how the menu worked. Another worker gave us free sandwich cards for our next visit, plus a free cookie. Also, one worker came around with free samples of their ribs. I would go back for the service alone but the food was great too.

I've been to other Texas de Brazil restaurants, specifically the one in Irvine, CA. This one lacked intimacy and the romantic vibe of the one in Irvine. Service was excellent, but the harsh surroundings made it seem more like a cafeteria than an upscale restaurant.  I will say the salad bar was excellent; but for the price I expected a darker, more romantic vibe for a date night out.
My first visit. Overall a good experience... the alloo gobi was over-cooked however. Otherwise the paneer-bell pepper was very good.

Red Lobster use to be my favorite restaurant but after the last two experiences I had at the King Of Prussia Location I am not sure If I will return. The restaurants cleanliness was unacceptable. The staff did not buss the tables so we had to eat next to tables with dirty dishes pulled sky high. The biscuits were delivered on paper towels which caused the paper towel to stick to the biscuits. I also had to send two sets of plates and forks back because they still had food on them. I was unable to enjoy my dinner due to all of the problems I experienced.

A friend recommended this place so we decided to give it a try. It is a short ride from the touristy district in case your are visiting NOLA.  The waitstaff was attentive and new the menu.  We had 2 waiters because one was in training. 
We tried the Alligator Cheese Cake, fried green tomatoes and the Duck and Andouille Gumbo.  Very tasty!  For entrees, we tried tHE BBQ Shrimp and the Blackened Redfish. Everything was well seasoned and tasted delicious.  I highly recommend this place!

Fish special was very good, a lil fishy but I like that myself.  There's enough food, for sure.  Coleslaw was outstanding.  Service was very pleasurable.  Smoked fish dip was phenomenal.  I wouldn't hesitate to return!!!

My Sister's and I gave this place a try. I ordered the deep fried taco's (Flauta's) the chicken inside was delicious. The sauce (green verde) had no heat at all and was over salted. My Sister's ordered a taco enchilada plate and Taco and tamale plate. Both said it was good, but not great. I ordered  Pina (pineapple) agua's frescas that was very watery and not sweet at all (no refills $3.99 a cup). My Sister's got lemonade (strawberry and regular) they came in big mugs and both said the drinks were good. The service was very slow. We waited about 15 min to flag down our waitress and ask for our check and another 15 to receive the check. I needed change to give a tip, so we tried to wait to get change but she never came back to get the payment? We ended up leaving after about 20 min waiting for her to come from out of the back/kitchen, unfortunately that left her with no tip. The food was just okay. The restaurant was very hot inside, they had a portable cooler with a fan going. Don't go if your in a hurry.

The food was absolutely amazing!!! Very flavorful, fresh and delicious! BUT when we ordered takeout we were told it was ready and when we went to pick it up we were told it would be ready in "just another few minutes" and we waited almost 2 HOURS for our food that we ordered almost 3 hours ago and was supposedly ready. It was absolutely absurd and it really saddens me because the food itself was so good but having to wait that long for our food that we told was ready is outrageous. I am not sure if we are willing to give them another shot but hopefully we can because the food was so good! Definitely go for the food be be warned that it might take an extra 2 hours!

This restaurant is disgusting!! What a waste of money.. Your food went in the trash!! Yes, it is by far the worse food in Pasco, many Florida.  I highly recommend not eating here. Pros: great selection of toppings, sauces, protein choices, base (aka: sweet potato noodles, brown rice/white rice and mixed greens) 

Location is right in the heart of downtown st. Pete..

Ambience was nice especially with various seating options..high and low tables inside, bar seat against the window for those who enjoy people watching...and outside for the sunshine 

Iced teas/lemonade selections were fun... with sample cups available for tasting 

Cons: $8 for one protein/$12 for two... why I put this in the con... I have been to various poke places in tampa and from a  price perspective..  I thought it was a bit high due to the amount of toppings that were included with the 2 prices above.

$8- one protein with 3 toppings after you chose a base (you can miX Salad with rice or noodLe/rice, etc) then you can pick only eXactly 3 toppings (I.e. jalapeños, masago, onions  for example...so anything else like crisp garlic topping or nori- would be .50 cent more) and 1 sauce otherwise it's another .50 cent...

$12 - you get 5 toppings... 

So the con part is that, most places let's you elect as many toppings as you want and charge a premium for say expensive items like avocado  or macadamia but not limit number of toppings and include sesame seeds/nori/garlic crips and doesn't charge for mixing of sauces like here...

Overall - taste wise and selections were good as long as you don't mind paying extra for everything..
